## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and its scope.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant automated tests pass.
- [ ] Packaged or real-host behavior was checked when the change affects packaging, GUI, Office, or integrations.
- [ ] Documentation and release impact were reviewed.
- [ ] No private documents, paths, credentials, generated caches, or internal plans are included.

## Compatibility and risk

List breaking changes, platform limits, data-writing behavior, and any acceptance that is still pending.
